about.title: Home is a flavour, a fabric, a sound. We deliver it.
about.intro: AfroTransact is a marketplace built for diaspora communities — the grocers, tailors, braiders, caterers and makers who keep culture alive far from home, and the families who shop with them.
about.photo: Photo: a seller’s shelf in Houston
about.pillar1: A verified storefront, payouts through Stripe, our warehouses and drivers, and tools that speak their language.
about.pillar2: Every community’s staples in one cart, with honest delivery dates and real people behind every shop.
about.pillar3: Local pickup, same-day delivery by our own drivers, and money that stays in the community.
about.story1: It started with a search for ofada rice in Houston that ended in a two-hour drive. The shops existed — they just weren’t online, couldn’t ship, or couldn’t take a card from someone three states away.
about.story2: So we built the rails: verified sellers, one checkout across many shops, our own warehouses and drivers, and a team that reviews every business before it sells. We started with African communities in the USA and now welcome every diaspora.
about.value1d: every seller is reviewed by a person
about.value2d: clear fees, fast payouts, honest delivery dates
about.value3d: we hire locally and sell what families actually cook
about.value4d: secure, accessible and boring where it matters
